input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a time period with a phrase meaning “the time of”; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当医生，医 is not normally used alone as the occupation noun in modern Chinese; 医生 means “doctor.” [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，The meaning is “see someone and then want to help,” so the perception has a result and needs the resultative complement 到. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，Use 别人 for other people in general; 别的 is used to distinguish a different one or different kind from a previously mentioned one. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，株 is the appropriate measure word for an individual plant; 个 is too generic here. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农听说：他听说，The name was used recently and no other singular character competes with it, so use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农三个月走去：他三个月走去，The same character remains the subject from the previous sentence, so a pronoun is more natural than repeating the name. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 三个月走去：走了三个月，A duration phrase follows the action verb, and 了 marks the three-month journey as completed. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 找到有植物的地方：找到了有植物的地方，This is the completed final action in the narrative sequence, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's time-expression rule, and 在古代 is correct.
医 cannot serve as the ordinary occupation noun here; 当医生 is correct.
The intended perception verb is 看到, but 一看到 alone is still an incomplete 一……就…… construction in the shown text.
别的人 is wrong here, but the intended referent is 病人, so replacing it with 别人 does not fully correct the learner's meaning.
一个植物 is acceptable Chinese, although 一株植物 is more specific and stylistically preferable.
神农 was just mentioned and no competing singular person is present, so the teacher's reference rule calls for 他.
The repeated name should be 他 under the close re-reference rule, but 他三个月走去 still retains the duration/aspect error.
The completed journey should be expressed as 走了三个月.
找到 already has a resultative complement and does not obligatorily require 了 here; moreover, it is not the final action of the scene.
